Holly / Marco —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I put together an initial activation roadmap and ownership sprint to get Marlin from kickoff to pilot in a predictable 6-week window. I attached two artifacts: 1) Marlin_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, dates, acceptance criteria) and 2) SOW-draft-20260520.pdf (commercial draft for your procurement).

High-level milestones (proposed) — target dates are listed, open for adjustment if they conflict with your calendar:
- Program kickoff (leadership + engineering + SRE) — target: 2026-06-02 — owner: Priya (Redwood) / Holly (Marlin)
- Data access & connector enablement (staging dataset + S3 role) — target: 2026-06-09 — owner: Marco (Marlin) / Karthik (Redwood SE)
- Integration smoke tests & inference validation — target: 2026-06-16 — owner: Karthik (Redwood) / Marlin Eng
- Pilot internal QA + acceptance signoff — target: 2026-06-23 — owner: Marlin Product / Marissa (Redwood CSM)
- Go‑live (pilot to production toggle, monitoring) — target: 2026-06-30 — owner: Marlin Ops / Redwood Dedicated Team

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm owners above (especially the data access contact and procurement lead).
2) Tell us if the kickoff needs to move — we can do Jun 2 or Jun 7.
3) Any SOW redlines (see comments in the PDF) — send procurement contact if you want us to route the document directly.

Operational notes and risks:
- Data access is the critical path. If we don't have S3 role or scoped dataset by Jun 9 we'll push the pilot by a week.
- We recommend a twice-weekly sync during the first two weeks of integration (Mon/Thu 30m).

Attachments: Marlin_MAP_v1.xlsx (worksheet), SOW-draft-20260520.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks — looking forward to locking these dates.
